summary: Line-by-line text comparison in a unified or side-by-side view.
whenToUse: Show changes to text, configuration, or code.
whenNotToUse: To edit text, use a dedicated editor.

props.name: before
props.description: Original text, treated as plain text.

props.name: after
props.description: Modified text, treated as plain text.

keyboard.action: Switches view and scrolls the comparison.

accessibility: Added and removed lines have text and symbols in addition to color.
responsive: The comparison scrolls within its own container on narrow viewports.
customization: Feedback colors and spacing derive from tokens.
commonMistakes: Do not use for very large files: the LCS comparison has an explicit limit.
limits: Line-based comparison, not word-based; limit of one million LCS cells.
